basic_info.description: Nestled in San Francisco's vibrant Crocker-Amazon neighborhood along the Excelsior Corridor, this beautifully updated 3-bed, 2-bath home blends vintage charm with modern comfort across 1,515 sq. ft. of inviting living space.    A freshly painted exterior opens to a bright interior with new light fixtures, fresh paint, and refinished hardwood floors. The spacious living room features crown molding, built-ins, and a cozy fireplace that flows into a formal dining room with classic wainscoting.     The updated kitchen shines with quartz counters, a tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. A versatile sunroom provides the perfect home office or reading nook, leading to a refreshed deck and laundry area.    Two bedrooms share a remodeled bath upstairs, while the flexible lower level includes a bedroom, bath, family room, and wet bar ideal for guests or extended living.    Outside, enjoy a low-maintenance yard with new fencing, a patio, and thoughtful landscaping. A one-car garage completes this delightful home.    Centrally located near Hwy 280, Balboa Park BART, Safeway, shops, dining, with San Bruno Mountain and McLaren Park trails, golf, and year-round Cow Palace events  this Crocker-Amazon gem perfectly balances character, comfort, and convenience.
